seed_ledger.name: Colossus 1 power station (gas supply)
seed_ledger.reason: ONSITE_NO_PIPE: A May 2024 MLGW agreement let an xAI affiliate build a short pipeline and metering facility tied into MLGW's existing gas line, so the supply is local distribution with no named transmission lateral. Cleanview describes mostly on-site turbines and names no pipeline. Colossus 2 and the Southaven turbines are a separate site; one news report says satellite images show a line from Texas Gas into the Southaven site, but no source gives length or operator for a new line. Searches run: 8. Sources checked: Yahoo/MLGW report (pipeline agreement with MLGW, no length), Cleanview report (no pipeline named), Data Center Dynamics on Southaven (Texas Gas lines seen on site), WDAM and WLOX on the Southaven permit (turbines only), Daily Memphian and 512 Pixels (power and turbines, no gas line), Wikipedia (no pipe), Shelby County permit coverage (15 turbines, no pipe), EIA and FERC searches (no lateral found).

evidence.note: MLGW pipeline agreement for a tie to its existing gas line
on-site gas and grid power, no pipeline named
Southaven site has Texas Gas lines; Colossus 2 site, not Colossus 1

seed_ledger.name: Dickson City Power Plant (gas supply)
seed_ledger.reason: NOT_FOUND: Three announced 133 MW units by a Kriger-linked developer (Dickson City Development LLC); the borough zoning denial was appealed in June 2026 per press cited by GOGPT. No source names a gas supplier, lateral, length or filing. Nearest lines are Atlantic Sunrise and Transco REAP, about 18 to 21 km, not confirmed. UGI signed gas service for the separate Lackawanna Energy Center, not this plant. PPL and Blackstone Archbald plants also name no pipeline. Searches run: 9. Sources checked: Times-Tribune via Yahoo (developer, zoning, no gas), WVIA on borough zoning (data centers only), PA DEP air permit search (nothing for Kriger or Dickson City), FERC and PUC (nothing found), PPL Blackstone coverage (no pipeline named), Spotlight PA and Grist (data centers only), NGI (unrelated), UGI/Williams/Transco searches (no link).

evidence.note: Dickson City Development LLC at Kriger address; no gas supply stated

seed_ledger.name: E.W. Brown Generating Station (gas supply)
seed_ledger.reason: ONSITE_NO_PIPE: KU testimony in PSC case 2025-00045 says Brown 12 (645 MW, 2030) will be served by the Tennessee Gas or Texas Eastern line that already serves the station, and only new on-site gas compression is needed; Tennessee Gas confirmed it has capacity. A 2017 estimate for an 11 mile 30 inch line to Brown was only a study. No new lateral or interstate expansion is named; data center tie is the utility's load-growth framing. Searches run: 9. Sources checked: KU Tummonds testimony (existing pipeline plus on-site compression), 2022-00402 gas line estimate (11 mile 30 inch option, preliminary), WEKU August 2026 (air permit, no pipeline), power-eng and PSC press releases (approval, no lateral), FERC prior notice searches (no Mercer County filing found), EIA workbook (no Brown project found), Data Center Dynamics (data center demand framing).

evidence.note: gas from existing Tennessee Gas or Texas Eastern; new on-site compression
older 11 mile study, not the plan
air permit and data center framing
